offer.text: One of my kin has the rot in them — the zombie-sickness. A golden apple and a steady hand can still pull them back from it. Please, hurry, before they turn for good.

accept.text: Go to them. The cure can't wait.

decline.text: Then we can only pray, and bar the door.

in_progress.text: Is my kin cured yet? Use the golden apple on them.

ready.text: They're whole again? Thank every star above.

complete.text: You gave my family their life back. We are forever in your debt.
